result.rationale: The migration backfills rows via raw SQL INSERT ('#{h}', ...) with no normalization, while EmbeddableHost strips scheme/path only in its before_validation hook, which raw INSERT bypasses. Since the old SiteSetting explicitly allowed values like 'http://eviltrout.com' (see removed specs like SiteSetting.embeddable_hosts = 'http://eviltrout.com'), migrated rows can retain the scheme, and record_for_host's lower(host) = uri.host comparison will fail, silently breaking embedding for previously-configured hosts. adjudication.rationale: In db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb the backfill uses raw SQL `INSERT INTO embeddable_hosts (host, ...) VALUES ('#{h}', ...)` for each line from the old `embeddable_hosts` site setting. This bypasses EmbeddableHost’s `before_validation` normalization that strips `http(s)://` and paths. Later, `EmbeddableHost.record_for_host(url)` parses the incoming URL and compares `where("lower(host) = ?", uri.host)`, so a migrated row like `http://example.com/123` (or with trailing `\r`) will not match `example.com`, causing `host_allowed?` checks to fail and embedding to break for migrated configurations.
